audit_items.proof_trace: Data column sidecars from Engine API bypass KZG proof verification at line 2176 guard `if !origin.is_from_el()`. While blob sidecars (Deneb) unconditionally verify KZG proofs (L1962-1970), data columns (PeerDAS/Fulu) skip cryptographic verification when origin is ExecutionLayer, violating the semi-trust assumption.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Compromised EL provides invalid data columns via engine_getBlobsV2. Columns bypass KZG verification due to ExecutionLayer origin tag (L2176), accepted without cryptographic validation (skipping L2186 verify_kzg_proofs), and propagated to P2P network causing consensus inconsistency.
